min_fan_speed.description: Minimum fan speed as RPM (e.g., '2000') or 'auto' to let mbpfan infer.

max_fan_speed.description: Maximum fan speed as RPM (e.g., '6200') or 'max' to allow full speed.

low_temp_threshold.description: Temperature (°C) at which fans switch to low speed.

medium_temp_threshold.description: Temperature (°C) at which fans switch to medium speed.

high_temp_threshold.description: Temperature (°C) at which fans switch to high speed.

poll_interval.description: Interval in seconds between temperature checks.

enabled.description: Whether mbpfan is enabled and should manage fans.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use 'syslog' to log to system journal instead.

allow_manual_override.description: Whether users can manually set fan speeds via sysfs (e.g., /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon0/fan1_input).

exclude_paths.description: List of thermal zone or hwmon paths to ignore when computing average temperature.

temp_sources.description: Override list of temperature sensor paths (leave empty to auto-detect).

fan_method.description: Fan control method: 'auto' (recommended), 'smc' (Apple System Management Controller), or legacy methods if supported.

kp.description: Proportional gain for PID fan control (used if PID is enabled via compiled-in or kernel support).

ki.description: Integral gain for PID fan control.

kd.description: Derivative gain for PID fan control.

integral_max.description: Maximum integral term to prevent wind-up in PID control.
